summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the bun executable, and then execFileSyncs it against a bundled file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled module with heavy identifier mangling (hex `_0x...` names), a large rotated constant array, and a string-array-shuffle decoder — the code cannot be audited without execution. The declared purpose of the package is a React component registry (dist/index.js and src/ contain unrelated TypeScript library code), and none of the library sources reference setup.mjs or math_init.js. The alternate-runtime dropper — fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to run an opaque bundled blob that the primary Node environment cannot easily introspect — executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer host on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
